Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely resolved an inherently ambiguous query by assuming “the person who took over the territory and made it part of their empire” referred to Alexander the Great based on a generic search hit. Instead of disambiguating (e.g., asking which territory/empire the user meant) as previously planned, the Planner locked onto the most prominent example and proceeded to fetch Alexander’s death date. This over-simplification of an ambiguous prompt risks producing a wrong answer if the user intended a different conqueror and territory.
